verdict.rationale: Trello documents several related features, but none is the product itself using AI to triage or prioritize incoming bugs or tasks. These include an Inbox for capturing items from email and Slack, generic workflow automation, an MCP server to 'Connect Trello to any AI tool', and an AI writing and editing helper. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks; an external AI connected via MCP would be a user-side construction, not native AI triage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
